description: Stores a complete snapshot of an LLM chat session.

main.description: A complete snapshot of an LLM chat session.

sessionId.description: Internal ID of the session. If any

createdAt.description: Date at which the session was created

turns.description: A turn is list of messages including the user prompt that initiated it and the responses from the LLM. A response can include multiple messages from different roles such as assistant, toolResult etc. A chat session can have multiple turns

api.description: Api format used (e.g. open-responses, openai-responses, openai-completions)

model.description: Name of the model used for this turn.

messages.description: List of messages of a turn

message.description: A single message in the conversation.

role.description: Role of the message author(e.g. user, assistant)

content.description: Ordered content blocks of the message.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp at which the message was generated

toolName.description: Name of the tool used in the tool call. If any

stopReason.description: The reason for stopping of the turn. If any

type.description: Type of message (e.g. text, thinking, toolCall)

text.description: Text content, if type is text

thinking.description: Thinking content, if type is thinking

name.description: Name of the tool, if type is toolCall

arguments.description: Arguments used in the toolCall in stringified JSON format
